Office tour used a fallback guide (Caleb Harris, teammate at the same Austin office) instead - see officeTourGuide resolution.
company_overview only has basic summary fields (name, category, employee count, offices) - no product description, ICP, or business-model detail exists anywhere in the source data.
DEMO ASSUMPTION (see prompts/process-expert.md): business-track LMS sessions 3-6 have no real source data behind them - descriptions are topical only.

This employee has 0 direct reports currently listed in the DB, despite being Manager-track (a newly-created CS-NA pod lead role) - per framework part B §4, Manager-track structure still applies (Manager Essentials training, manager-shaped career content), but no direct_report 1:1s were scheduled since there is genuinely no one to schedule them with yet. This will need re-running once reports are assigned to her.

JD Extractor found no conflicts between the job posting and the Roles catalog (ROLE-015, Customer Success Manager, Manager track, M2-M3) - track and scope both check out (a single-pod lead maps to M2 'Manager', not M3 'Director' which requires multiple teams). Noted for completeness, not because anything needs resolving.

jdExtract.seniorityIndicators.scopeOrPortfolio ("$10M+ ARR portfolio") comes from the posting's Requirements section (a candidate qualification bar), not its Responsibilities section - it is not a confirmed statement of this role's actual assigned scope at Veridian. Role-track content hedges this deliberately ("a large portfolio") rather than repeating the exact figure as settled fact.
The department overview (week 4) defaults to the direct manager as facilitator since no dedicated 'Trainer' role exists in this dataset.
This agent does not generate applied 'doing' work tickets (out of scope by design) - actual work assignments should come from the employee's manager/team backlog, not this plan.
